name: Topol
description: The Topol was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. The Topol was part of a group of three Dreadnaught-class cruisers, along with the Lupo and the Nicodemus, that were fitted with explosives in order to ram and destroy the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Vengeance during the Battle of Nocto.
